verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 documents a session supervisor for background workers and agent runtimes that outlive an SDK call. It also supports auto_resume, so inbound access can wake a paused sandbox, and Sandbox Functions expose HTTP handlers without a long-lived server. Together these let agent workloads run and be triggered in the background, but this is infrastructure for automations rather than a first-party way to define them; GitHub Actions orchestration relies on an external platform and earns no credit. Missing for 10: a first-party scheduler or cron triggers, a documented way to define and set up automations, and independent or hands-on corroboration of autonomous background runs.
